info.description: Routes of OpenVibe.Bench as the OpenVibe contracts describe them (openvibe-contracts 0.272.0): each operation lists the capabilities it performs; a token for the service's audience must carry one of them unless the route is open. bench.benchmark.v1.title: BenchBenchmark
bench.benchmark.v1.description: bench.benchmark@1: a versioned, forkable benchmark on OpenVibe.Bench (spec 2026-10-30, stage B1). It holds the tasks, the judges, how they combine into one score, the limits a run may not pass, the default model and harness matrix, and the visibility of the set. A version is immutable once a run names it; a fork records its parent. Holdout tasks are hidden from everyone but the executor.

id.description: The benchmark id; the same id carries every version.

owner.description: Who owns the set: a person (usr_…), a project (prj_…) or a service.

kind.description: One of Bench's kinds; the kind sets the renderer.

visibility.description: public appears in the registry; unlisted is reachable by id only.

version.description: The version number this document is.

parent.description: The benchmark id@version this one was forked from, or null.

expected.description: What a correct answer looks like; the judge reads it.

holdout.description: A hidden task: it is withheld from everyone but the executor, against tuning to the set.

version.description: The pinned judge version; a run names the judge it used.

ms.description: The time one task may take.

usd.description: The money one run may spend.

bench.entry.v1.title: BenchEntry
bench.entry.v1.description: bench.entry@1: one submitted entry in a benchmark round on OpenVibe.Bench. PROVIDER and MODEL name the offer; ROUTE is the exact route taken; PAYLOAD is the entry's output; COST_USD, MS and TOKENS are the measured use.

bench.judgement.v1.title: BenchJudgement
bench.judgement.v1.description: bench.judgement@1: a blind judgement cast on a benchmark round on OpenVibe.Bench. JUDGE names the judge (pair, rubric, automatic_grader, test_suite, game_outcome); METHOD is how the pair was decided; PAIR is the two entry ids; OUTCOME and SCORE are the result.

bench.kind.v1.title: BenchKind
bench.kind.v1.description: bench.kind@1: a benchmark kind on OpenVibe.Bench. ROOM is the room that owns the kind, ENTRY the shape a submitted entry takes, JUDGE the default judge (pair, rubric, automatic_grader, test_suite or game_outcome), NAME the display name, SCHEMA the entry JSON Schema, and METRICS the board metrics (elo, pareto, cost, or a room's own).

bench.rating.v1.title: BenchRating
bench.rating.v1.description: bench.rating@1: a rating on a benchmark board on OpenVibe.Bench. CATEGORY and SUBJECT identify what is rated (a model, a route or a room's own subject); ELO, GAMES, WINS, LOSSES, TIES and WIN_RATE are the score; CI_LOWER and CI_UPPER bound the estimate.

bench.round.v1.title: BenchRound
bench.round.v1.description: bench.round@1: a pinned, reproducible benchmark round on OpenVibe.Bench. TASK_ID names the task; OFFERS are the exact offers (provider, model, route) the round runs; STATUS follows queued, running, ready, finished or failed; SEED and RECEIPT make the round reproducible.

bench.run.v1.title: BenchRun
bench.run.v1.description: bench.run@1: one result on OpenVibe.Bench (spec 2026-10-30, stage B1): a benchmark version × a model × a harness × settings × who ran it. It records the environment, the per-task scores, cost, time and tokens, the rendered artifacts, and the provenance: verified (executed by openvibe.codes or a Run worker) or submitted (posted through the API with no executor). Submitted runs are badged and kept out of the default rankings.

benchmark.description: The benchmark id@version the run names. The version is immutable once a run names it.

route.description: The route that produced the run.

hardware.description: The machine for a local model: GPU, CPU, RAM, quantization.

score.description: The benchmark's one score for this run, 0-100.

provenance.description: verified: an executor ran it. submitted: posted with no executor, badged and out of the default rankings.

kind.description: codes: an openvibe.codes task. run: a Run worker. node: the person's own machine. submitted: nobody ran it.

bench.task.v1.title: BenchTask
bench.task.v1.description: bench.task@1: a benchmark task on OpenVibe.Bench. KIND_ID names the kind; PROMPT is the task; TASK_CLASS is an optional classifier for grouping; PUBLIC says whether the task may appear in the open dataset.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
